first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: Multiple ping pong balls are shown, illustrating different stages of a rally. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: Ensure the ping pong balls are clearly visible and distinct against the background.
Show the balls in various positions to suggest motion or different stages of play.
Maintain consistent lighting and camera angle throughout the sequence.
Include at least one ball in motion to imply the rally is in progress.
